card.name: Just before 'every' time intervals
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected 'every N hours/weeks/years' phrase, often after a dose, an event, or an average. It fires on the last word before 'every' or 'once every'.

modes.label: Dosing before every
modes.description: The drug, dose unit or route word right before 'every' plus a time span.
modes.example: Subsequent doses (starting 6 months from the first infusion): single 300 mg intravenous<< infusion>> every 6 months.

modes.label: Rates and averages
modes.description: Words in general text just before a frequency such as 'every 6 weeks' or 'once every 7-8 years'.
modes.example: He was involved in an event of violence on the average<< of>> every 6 weeks for the last

modes.label: Other words before every
modes.description: Parts of words like the end of a name or verb that precede 'every' or a time span.
modes.example: This results in the death of an orang<<utan>> every 2 hours.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with time-limit words such as 'until' and 'till'.
